Commentary.Commentary: From 117-5 and then 161-7, it's been a fantastic comeback from the South Africans. Not surprising really as they have done this throughout the series, often coming out of crunch situations comprehensively. A sporting declaration from Faf means Australia have to phase a tricky 12-over phase before stumps under lights against this swinging ball. The last time a team declared on day 1 was when Australia did so against India at Hyderabad in 2013. Coincidentally, he was on air this time when the declaration happened. The Aussie innings isn't far away.

A sporting declaration from Faf du Plessis to cap what has been his day. The South African skipper compiled a masterclass century - his 6th in Tests and second at this venue to bail the Proteas out of trouble. The track seamed and swung throughout but Faf was undeterred as he marched on fluidly with classy shots. His stands with Cook and Abbott were vital to rescue South Africa. Hazlewood was the star for Australia with a 4-fer while the other bowlers were patchy.

FOUR! Launched! Full ball outside off, Faf stays in the crease and lofts it cleanly over mid off. Beautiful strike and that's a boundary to him. WITH THAT, HE HAS DECIDED TO DECLARE SOUTH AFRICA'S INNINGS on 259/9!
The yorker goes wrong and a full toss results. Shamsi clubs it through mid-wicket. Good running gives them three more.
Starc fires this down the leg side, Shamsi looks to flick but misses.
Shamsi's adventure continues! Full ball around off, he slices it over point. Another brace taken.
Length ball wider outside off, Shamsi goes for the booming drive but he was noway near it.
Fullish outside off, bunted strongly towards mid off. Single taken. Faf is gutted as he thought that was a boundary for the taking.
Short ball on middle, Shamsi sits under the bumper.
FOUR! NAILS THIS! Length ball on off, Shamsi clobbers the heave over mid-wicket. Struck it well and the ball races away to the fence for a boundary.
Over mid off this time! Not in control once more as he tries to swing at a length ball. The miscue goes over the fielder and another brace results.
Shamsi goes for a heave! Back of a length on off, he swings at it and skews it just over mid on for a brace.
Shortish on off, blocked off the back foot solidly to the leg side.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to point for a single.
JOSH HAZLEWOOD comes back on a bowl.
Another short ball and Shamsi once again evades it.
Fullish and outside off, Shamsi middles the drive well but straight to mid off.
Another bouncer and this time Shamsi ducks well under it. Too high and wide called.
Four Leg byes! Dug in short on middle, Shamsi ducks but the ball hits him flush on the elbow. The ball rebounds and goes down to the fine leg fence.
Length ball outside off, Shamsi flirts at it without any footwork and is lucky not to get a nick.
Good length on middle and leg, worked behind square for a single.

What a ball! Back of a length angled in closer to off, takes off after pitching to zip past the outside edge. Faf was lookg to block but couldn't handle the lift off the surface. For a man batting on a hundred, it's an unusual sight and tells you about this Adelaide track.
Loopy on middle, Faf uses his feet and clips it through mid-wicket. Gets the single to keep strike.
FOUR! Goes big down the ground! Drifting in from around off, du Plessis steps out to that one and lifts it straight down the ground. Just a couple of bounces before going past the long off ropes.
Tossed up on off, Faf skips down the track and whips it towards mid-wicket.
Flighted around off, defended well off the front foot.
Drifting in on middle, Faf gets back and clips it with the turn to the leg side.
Floated and spinning down the leg side, Faf misses the flick. Wade whips off the bails but the SA skipper was in the crease.
Fuller outside off, Shamsi pushes hard at it but gets the thick edge. Doesn't carry to Smith at second slip.
Another bouncer on middle, Shamsi doesn't play at it.
Dug in short on middle and leg, Shamsi ducks under the bouncer.
Length ball directed at the pads, Shamsi tries to jam it but the ball goes off the leading edge to the off side.
Shortish around leg stump, Shamsi stays back to fend but is hit on the thigh pad. When is that yorker coming?
Dug in short around leg stump, Shamsi ducks under the bumper.
MITCHELL STARC is back on.
FOUR! Finds the gap! Square leg was up to prevent the single and Faf gets the sweep well behind square. Connected well and the placement was perfect too. Another boundary to the skipper.
Floated on a length outside off, blocked off the back foot towards point. Single taken.
Fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot.

FOUR! Whoa, Shamsi has got a healthy piece of that one. Tossed up nicely on middle, he gets under it and lifts it cleanly over wide mid on. Connected it well as the ball raced away to the fence for a boundary.
Floated around off, spins in sharply to rap Shamsi high on the thigh. It almost rebounded to hit the back of the bat.
TABRAIZ SHAMSI is the last man in.

OUT! SHARP STUFF FROM WADE! This was a floated off break around off, Rabada lunged into it to block but the ball whizzes past the outside edge. He slightly overbalances and Wade was quick to whip off the bails. They go upstairs and replays confirm that Kagiso doesn't have any part of the foot behind the line. Lyon is a relieved man, a Test wicket after almost 110 overs i.e. three innings.
DRINKS!
On middle and leg, clipped straight to mid-wicket from his crease.
Angled on a length on off, Faf plays it back down the wicket from his crease.
Outside off, Faf defends it towards covers.
Nudges it through backward square leg for a single.
Length ball outside off, left alone by Rabada.
Good length outside off, punched towards extra cover for a single.
Floated outside off, no shot offered by Rabada.
Fuller outside off, Rabada drives it towards covers.
On middle, Rabada defends it.
Goes back and works it through the on side for a single.
6th Test ton for Faf du Plessis!

He came, they booed but he has conquered! What a knock this has been from Faf du Plessis! He averages 204 at this ground and a ton should tell you how much he loves batting here. Coming to the ball, it was outside off, Faf got across, paddled it down to the fine leg region for a couple to bring up his ton. He raises his bat to celebrate his ton and what a knock it has been. After all that has happened in the last few days, this is superb from Faf! Talk about the captain leading from  the front, boy he will be delighted with this effort. Nice to see Smith applauding too.
Floated outside off, Faf comes forward and defends it.
KAGISO RABADA walks in to bat.

OUT! PLUMB! One ball that is hitting the stumps and Abbott has to walk back. Fuller outside off, middle, comes in a touch, Abbott looks to clip it through but is rapped on the pads. The players go up in an appeal and the umpire upholds it. Abbott comes over to have a chat with Faf who informs him that that was pretty adjacent and hence Abbott does not review. A wicket at last for Australia in the session.
Fuller on middle and leg, clipped to short mid-wicket by Abbott.
Outside off, Abbott defends it off the outer half towards covers.
Stays back and pushes it towards mid on from the crease.
Good length on off, Abbott comes across and defends it.
Good length outside off, pushed towards covers for a single.
BIRD has a change of ends.
Tossed up outside off, another solid block by Abbott.
Floated outside off, Abbott comes forward and defends it.
Shorter outside off, punched towards backward point by Abbott.
Fuller on off, Abbot looks to turn but does so off the inner half.
Faf comes forward and turns it off the inside edge past short leg for a single.
Outside off, left alone.
LYON comes back on for a bowl.
Outside off, Faf gets an inside edge towards square leg for a single towards square leg.
Outside off, Faf looks to play at first but then lets it go.
Back of a length outside off, Faf defends it back.
50-run stand up between Faf and Abbott!
FOUR! Faf continues to flourish! Bowls it outside off, Faf comes forward and drives it nicely wide of mid off for a boundary.
WIDE! Shorter length on the stumps, Faf looks to pull but then spots that it is too short and he lets it go over him. A wide is signaled for height.
Outside off, Faf comes forward and defends it.
FOUR! NOBODY MOVED! Fuller outside off, Faf gets on top and caresses it through extra cover for a boundary. What a superb shot, that!
Fuller on the stumps, clipped through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Abbott pushes it towards mid on from the crease.

Fuller in length on middle, Faf hits it on the rise back down the wicket to the left of the umpire. Warner from mid off gives it a chase and fires a throw in. Three runs taken but Warner has hurt his shoulder again.
Abbott pushes it through mid on from the crease. They come back for the third.
du Plessis defends it towards the off side for a single.
Angled outside off, comes in a touch, Faf defends it back down the wicket.
Shorter length outside off, ducked under by Abbott.
Good length outside off, left alone.
Fuller outside off, Abbott pushes it back down the wicket.
Good length on off, tucked towards mid-wicket for a single. Faf wanted the second but was sent back in time by Abbott.
Outside off, Faf lets it go through safely.
Fuller outside off, driven towards mid off by Faf.
JOSH has a change of ends.
Good length outside off, Abbott lets it go through.
Fuller outside off, Abbott presses forward and pushes it to covers.
Outside off, no shot offered by Abbott.
Angled on a length on off, Abbott defends it back down the wicket.
Outside off, on a length, left alone.
Good length outside off, played towards point from his crease.
BIRD returns for a bowl.
FOUR! SLAPPED! Shorter outside off, Faf gets on top of it and cuts it hard through backward point for a boundary. Moves into the 80s!
Full outside off, pushed to Lyon for a quick single.

Fuller outside off, Faf drives it towards extra cover and takes a quick single. A bit of drama there as Abbott drops his bat midway. Warner also seems to have hurt his right shoulder trying to throw that one.
Low full toss outside off, Abbott pushes it down the ground. Warner gives it a chase from mid off and they get three runs.
Fuller outside off, driven to Lyon at cover-point by Abbott. Lyon suggests it did not pick that one at all.
Bowls the yorker outside off, kept out by Abbott from his crease.
Angled on a length on off, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, left alone by Abbott.
Back of a length ball on off, pulled to deep square leg for a single.
Good length outside off, Faf lets it be.
A length ball outside off, left alone.
FOUR! SMASHED! Good length outside off, sits up and asking to be hit, Faf obliges and smashes it to the cover fence for a boundary.
Bowled down the leg side, Abbott fails to clip it through.
Bouncer! Abbott ducks under this bumper from Starc.
Faf plays it through covers for a single.
Words being exchanged! Wade and Faf almost bumped into each other on the previous ball and Wade has his love shared towards Faf. The umpire asks them to stay put.
Fuller on middle, clipped through mid-wicket for three runs.
Fuller outside off, Faf pushes his drive towards Khawaja at extra cover for a single.
Angled on middle, tucked towards mid-wicket for a single. The fielder is slow, Lyon that is and they get a couple at the end.
Good length outside off, Abbott pushes it towards covers.
Fuller outside off, Abbott drives it to covers from his crease.
Played through covers for a single.
Faf stays back and defends it from his crease.
Back of a length outside off, Faf defends it.
Good length outside off, Faf gets it through covers for a couple of runs.

What happened there? Bowls it outside off on a back of a length, Abbott gets into an awkward tangle as he tries to fend that away. The ball goes off the gloves onto his neck and falls away from the stumps. Abbott is surprised, Faf has a worried look while Starc has an evil grin on his face. Such beauty, cricket!
Abbott comes ahead a touch and pushes it towards covers.
Angled on a length outside off, left alone by Abbott.
Fuller outside off, Abbott pushes it towards mid on from the inside half of the bat.
Spears in the yorker on middle, Abbott looks to clip it through but gets a leading edge towards covers.
Angled outside off, Abbott comes forward and pushes it towards covers.
MITCHELL STARC to bowl from the other end.
Good length outside off, Faf flat bats it towards covers from his crease.
On a length outside off, left alone by du Plessis.
Fuller on off, Abbott clips it through mid-wicket for a triple for the first runs in the session.
Fuller outside off, played towards mid on from the crease with a nice forward press by Abbott.
Angled on a length on off, Abbott comes forward and defends it.
Good length on off, comes in a touch, Abbott defends it towards mid-wicket.

Welcome back for the final session of play! FAF DU PLESSIS and KYLE ABBOTT come out to bat for South Africa. How will they go about the innings now? Will they look for quick runs or will they bide their time? Let's see. Australia begin with JOSH HAZLEWOOD, who is looking for his fifth wicket! Here we go...
DAY 1... SESSION 3...

Hazlewood has been the best bowler for the home side with four wickets. Australia will want to wrap things up early since they know the visitors have enough potency to wreck havoc on this wicket under lights. It promises to be an entertaining session. Do join us for it in a while.

Another eventful session of Test cricket! Plenty of wickets for Australia there as they stay on top for now. Faf du Plessis has been the lone warrior for South Africa and has led from the front with a gritty fifty. Cook did not make his start count and neither did de Kock who looked good in a short cameo. How Faf goes about his work from here could prove decisive.
Length ball on off, Faf defends it solidly from the crease. THAT SHALL BE THE DINNER BREAK ON DAY 1.
Good length closer to off, Faf isn't interested to play at it.
Fullish outside off, Abbott leans into it and caresses it towards cover for a run.
Dug in short on middle and leg, Faf controls the pull shot in front of square for a single.
Short of a length outside off, Faf goes back on his toes to tap it to the off side.
Good length well wide outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Almost got his fifer! Length ball in the corridor of uncertainty, Abbott pushes at it and makes a late decision to withdraw his bat. He is lucky not to get a nick there.
Good length on off, nips in a bit as Abbott defends it solidly off the back foot to the leg side.
Fullish outside off, Faf bludgeons the drive towards mid off where Warner makes a terrific diving stop. Saved a certain boundary there. Cannot prevent the single though.
Length ball around off, nips in a bit with slightly lower bounce as Faf adjusts to jam it to mid-wicket.
Good length closer to off, good bounce as Faf makes a leave to that one.
Good length outside off, Faf makes a leave to that one.
Good length closer to off, Abbott doesn't offer a shot to that one.
Length ball outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Length ball outside off, Abbott stays back and defends it out.
Good length outside off, blocked off the back foot to the off side.
Wide yorker outside off, Abbott just about manages to dig it out.
Fuller on middle and leg, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
KYLE ABBOTT is the new man in.

OUT! PHILANDER HAS TO GO! Have to admit it was a very debatable decision. Back of a length around off, nips back in sharply, Philander hangs back to fend at it as the ball goes off the pads. It lobs high towards Wade who collects it with glee. The Australians feel there is a faint inside edge and the umpire obliges to the appeal as well. Vernon immediately goes for the review. Looked like it came off the back thigh although Snicko does show a very slight spike. Nothing on Hot Spot. The third umpire reckons it could be the faintest of inside edges. So, the on-field call is upheld and Philander has to go. This call may ignite a controversy probably. Australia on a roll at the moment. Hazlewood has four now.
Philander has been given out caught behind. He opts for the review.
Good length outside off, blocked off the front foot.
Another man goes back in the deep at square leg.
FOUR! Top shot from Philander! He can bat for sure and he has showed it this series. This is a short ball and he responds with a mighty pull through square leg to find the fence.
Full and shaping in from off, Philander gets across and drives it towards mid on.
The lights are just about turning on at the Adelaide Oval.
Good length closer to off, a bit of nip inward with bounce as Vernon lets it pass.
Fuller and around off, pushed off the front foot towards cover.
Dug in short on off, Faf ducks comfortably under the bumper.
Good length well outside off, that's an easy leave for Faf.
Good length angled in on off, du Plessis hops across and blocks it solidly.

FOUR! Edged...but in the gap! Another full ball outside off, Faf throws his hands at it but the ball squirts off the outside edge. In the air but also between the slips and gully as it races to the third man fence.
FOUR! Imperious shot! Full and outside off, width on offer and Faf reaches out to play a scorching drive through the covers to find the fence.
Length ball angled in from well outside off, no shot offered to that one.
MITCHELL STARC is back on.
Fuller outside off, Philander leans into it and pushes it towards mid off.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Fuller and tailing into middle and leg, Philander tucks it towards mid-wicket.
VERNON PHILANDER walks out to bat.

OUT! Hazlewood has another! This is a huge wicket too, considering de Kock's ominous form. Length ball on middle and leg, nips away off the seam as Quinton pushes tentatively at it. The outside edge flies through to Wade who takes another comfortable catch. The Australians getting timely strikes.
Fuller and drifting on the pads, de Kock clips it through square leg for a brace.
Back of a length on off, worked off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
Loopy around off, Faf presses forward and dead bats it.
Fuller on middle and leg, de Kock clips it behind square for a single.
Fuller on leg stump, worked deftly towards mid-wicket.
Floated outside off, blocked solidly off the back foot.
Fuller outside off, driven off the front foot towards mid off.
FOUR! De Kock continues to race along! Short and outside off, asking to be hit and he obliges with a slap through the covers to get a boundary. He is playing his shots with audacity.
Length ball outside off, no shot offered to that one either.
Good length outside off, good bounce and carry as Faf lets it pass.
Length ball just outside off, du Plessis doesn't offer a shot to that one.
FOUR! Finds the gap this time! Once again shortish outside off, Faf stays back and delays the cut shot to find the gap at point. Gets the boundary with ease.
Short of a length outside off, Faf stays back and slaps it towards point.
Good length on leg stump, de Kock clips it down to fine leg for a single.
JOSH HAZLEWOOD comes back in for another spell.
Drifting in on middle and leg, tucked behind square for a single.

TOP EDGE FALLS SAFE! Another slightly nervy moment for de Kock and it's against Lyon again. It was floated around off and Quinton went for the slog sweep. Got the top edge but luckily for him, it landed short of the man at deep backward square leg. Brace added.
Drifting in from around off, de Kock pushes at it but the ball goes off the inside half towards forward short leg.
Flighted outside off, driven fluently off the front foot but straight to mid off.

FOUR! EMPHATIC SHOT! Floated on middle and leg, de Kock steps out to that one and lofts it cleanly down the ground. Just goes on the bounce to the long on fence. Nimble footwork was the key in this stroke.
Flatter outside off, defended well off the back foot to the off side.
Length ball outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Fuller on the pads, clipped through square leg for a single.
9th Test fifty for Faf.

Length ball on middle, Faf shuffles and clips it towards mid-wicket for a single. Fine knock so far from the SA captain. He likes this venue, doesn't he? Shone on Test debut here in that historic draw and this has been another good knock especially considering all the controversy around him in recent times.
Good length on leg stump, worked down to fine leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, flowing drive from de Kock towards mid off.
Good length around off, not much room as de Kock looks to glide it with an open bat face. Jabs it on the bounce to second slip where Smith makes a good stop.
Flighted around off, du Plessis gets back and defends it well.
Floated around off, Faf stays in the crease and defends it well.
Floated on leg stump, worked away on the leg side for a single.
Fuller outside off, defended off the front foot.

De kock gets lucky! Flighted outside off, he goes for the slog sweep but gets it off the bottom half towards mid off. Just short of the fielder. Would have looked really silly if he had got out to this shot.
Floated around off, de Kock pushes it with soft hands towards point.
Pitched up on off, Faf pushes at it but the ball goes off the outer half towards cover.
Length ball outside off, Quinton gets a stride forward and pushes it sweetly towards cover for a single.
Length ball around off, de Kock defends it solidly from the crease.
Fullish around off, firmly driven by Faf towards Bird who gets a hand on it. Not a clean stop and the ball beats mid off to the deep. Three runs added.
Good length outside off, shaping away, no shot offered to that one.
Fullish on middle and leg, Faf jams it out towards mid on.
Flatter outside off, stays back and cuts it to the off side.
Fuller around off, defended off the front foot to the covers.
Flatter outside off, defends it from the crease to the off side.
Fuller around off, defended well off the front foot.

FOUR! Wrong length and punished! Slightly short outside off, de Kock stays back to that one and cuts it away through point for a boundary. This is the quality de Kock has - he'll punish anything loose.
That's a peach! Floated around off, turns away to beat the outside edge as de Kock tries to push at it.
Good length closer to off, Faf gets behind the line and blocks it to cover.
Fullish and outside off, some shape away but the line is too wide to make du Plessis play.
Good length closer to off, Faf lifts his bat to make the leave.
Short around leg stump, de Kock swivels to pull it down to fine leg for a single.
Fuller around off, pushed off the outer half towards cover.
QUINTON DE KOCK walks out to the middle. He has been in good form, can he get his team out of trouble yet again?
DRINKS!

OUT! A tame poke does Bavuma in! Good length outside off, Bavuma defends it from his crease but gets an outside edge that goes through to the keeper for a simple catch. Bavuma was beaten by the late away movement. Australia have South Africa on the mat here, will they make it count from here on?
Fuller on off, Bavuma pushes it to Starc at mid off and takes him on for a quick single and completes it in time.
Turns in from outside of, Bavuma tucks it towards short leg from his crease.
Shorter on off, worked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Faf stays back and keeps this one out from his crease.
Tossed up outside off, Faf defends it towards mid on, but the bowler goes to his right and stops it.
Floated way outside off, no shot offered by Faf.
Outside off, pushed towards point by Bavuma from his crease.
Shorter length outside off, Bavuma shapes to pull at first but then aborts his shot.
Length ball on off, Bavuma pushes it to covers from his crease.
Good length on off, coming in, Bavuma looks to pull it through but is hit on the box. Ouch!
Fuller outside off, no shot offered by Bavuma.
On a length on off, Bavuma comes forward and defends it.
This one turns in from outside off, Faf does well to keep it down towards the vacant leg gully region.
Fuller outside off, Faf comes across and defends it.
Slants it on the pads, clipped through backward square leg for a single.
Tossed up on off, turned towards short mid-wicket off the inside half of the bat.
Shorter outside off, Bavuma looks to go besides the ball and slap it through covers but finds the fielder.
Floated outside off, Bavuma comes forward to defend but gets an inside edge towards short leg.
BEATEN! In the channel outside off, Faf has to play at it, he does so but fails to put bat to ball.
Slanted down the leg side on a length ball, left alone by Faf.
Too full outside off, pushed towards covers by Faf.

FOUR! EDGED! Outside off on a length, pitches and goes away, Faf pushes at it and gets an outside edge through gully. Handscomb, Smith, Renshaw all run after it but cannot stop the ball. He didn't have total control but did well to get it down with soft hands.
Good length outside off, Faf stays back and defends it back to the bowler.
Outside off on a fuller length, left alone.
BIRD comes back on for a spell.
Outside off, Bavuma mistimes his drive towards mid off.
Bavuma looks to clip it through but goes through Handscomb at short leg. That hit him on the left elbow. Those need to lob up and stick. Tough chance!
Outside off, Bavuma gets across and defends it with an angled face of the bat.
Floated on middle, turned towards backward square leg.
Faf drives it through mid on for a single. Easily let that one through reckons KP on air. He wants Smith to force the batsmen to take more risks to score.
Fuller on off, Faf turns it towards short mid-wicket.
LYON returns for a bowl. He bowled a good first spell, hitting the right areas. Can he continue the good work? A slip and a short leg in place.
The physio is out in the middle, attending Faf who was hit on his right elbow.
A touch short outside off, Bavuma takes the bottom hand off that one and fends it safely though.
Back of a length on middle and leg, Bavuma tucks it through backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Sprayed outside off, on a fuller length, Bavuma is not tempted into the push yet.
Shorter length outside off, Bavuma lets it go over him.
Fuller outside off, Bavuma looks to drive but gets it off the inside half back down the wicket.
Sprayed outside off, left alone by Bavuma.
Good length outside off, Faf keeps it out square of the wicket from his crease.
Angled on a length outside off, comes in a long way, Faf is hit on his back elbow. No harm done though.
Good length on off, Faf hops and tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, du Plessis punches it on the bounce towards extra cover.
Pushes this one through mid on.
Pushes this one towards point from his crease.
Faf slaps it through mid off for a single from his crease.
This one is wide enough for Faf to leave.
Fuller but outside leg, Bavuma clips it on the bounce to fine leg for a single.
GLOVED! Back of a length on middle, Bavuma fends at it. The ball goes off the gloves towards first slip where Renshaw cannot get to it. Bavuma survives a scare!
Tucks this through square leg for a single.
Full and very wide outside off, left alone by Faf.
SHOT! Full outside off, pushed nicely through extra covers for a couple fo runs.
This time it is on a length on off, Bavuma defends it.
Hurls it on a good length outside off, Bavuma lets it go.
Bouncer! Bowls it  back of a length on off, Bavuma gets out of the way and lets it go through.
Similar length but a bit more wide, same reaction from Bavuma.
Good length outside off, Bavuma lets it go through.
Angled on a fuller length, clipped through mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! Top batting! Goes around the wicket to Faf, bowls it short outside off, Faf gets on top of it and cuts it past Lyon at cover-point for a boundary. 100 up for South Africa!
Bavuma clips it in the air through square leg for a single.
Slanted across off, on a fuller length, Temba lets it go through.
Bouncer! Starts off with a 146 kph bumper, Bavuma lets it go over him.
TEMBA BAVUMA strides out to bat.

OUT! Starc gets rid of Cook and once again he checks behind to see if it is a no ball! On a length outside off, Cook feels for it away from his body and gets an outside edge and Smith at second slip gobbles the catch. Cook does not make the Australians pay and he departs after a start. There was no need to play at that but Cook was very loose there.
Angled on a fuller length on off, Faf presents the full face and gets it towards mid on.
Shorter length outside off, Faf ducks under it.
Hurls it outside off, Faf comes forward and pushes it to cover-point.
Good length outside off, left alone by Faf.
Angled on a length on off, Faf defends it well.
Good length on off, Faf defends it back down the wicket.
This one is going away, left alone by Cook.
Back of a length on middle, tucked towards mid-wicket from his crease.
An easy leave for Cook.
50-run stand up between Cook and Faf!
Fuller on middle, Faf clips it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. the fielder does well in the deep but they come back for the third.
Angles it fuller outside off, Faf comes forward and defends it.
Goes round the wicket, bowls it full on off, played back to the bowler.
Cook presses forward and pushes it to covers from his crease.
Bouncer! Josh serves a bumper, Cook ducks under it.
Pitched up outside off, played back to the bowler again.
Fuller outside off, Cook drives it back to the bowler who mimes the throw but loses his balance a touch and ends up smiling about it.
On off, Cook comes forward and defends it towards mid-wicket.
Clipped! Fuller and angling into the stumps, Faf clips it through mid-wicket. The ball slowed down and that allowed Nic to save it in time. Saves a run for his side.
JOSH HAZLEWOOD to bowl from the other end.
Full outside off, Cook places it towards covers but not in the gap.
Back of a length on off, Cook rides the bounce and taps it back down the wicket.
Full outside off at 142.6 kph, Cook drives it towards covers without any foot work.
On a length on off, Cook comes forward and defends it.
Good length outside off, Cook raises his bat and lets it go through.
Bowls it outside off, Cook defends it from his crease.
Welcome back for the second session of play! FAF DU PLESSIS and STEPHEN COOK come out to continue batting. Australia begin the session with MITCHELL STARC! Here we go...
DAY 1... SESSION 2...

Josh Hazlewood was the pick of the bowlers for Australia constantly making the batsmen play. He dismissed both Amla and JP in fine fashion and will be vital for Australia's chances in the game. Starc will want to not spray the ball around much. The hosts have faced middle order resistance from South Africa and will want to ensure there is no repeat. Do join us in a while for the second session.

A grinding session of Test cricket, an even one for both the teams! South Africa won the toss and elected to bat in their first ever D/N Test. Australia did spray the new ball around at the start but got into their own and things went their way with Starc taking the customary first wicket of the innings. Cook was given a reprieve when Starc had him trapped in front but had overstepped. He has made them pay till now and will be hoping to carry on the good work with his skipper, Faf.
Floated well outside off, Faf leans into it and smothers it to the ground. THAT SHALL BE TEA ON DAY 1.
Tossed up outside off, du Plessis presses forward to that one and defends it.
Drifting in from outside off, nicely blocked off the front foot.
Tossed up outside off, defended well off the front foot towards forward short leg.
Quicker on off, turning in, Faf stays back and is cramped for room. Jabs it to the covers.
Flatter on off, worked off the back foot to mid-wicket where it is well stopped.
Good length outside off, blocked off the back foot towards the covers.
Good length a bit wider outside off, shaping away, easily left alone.
Length ball closer to off, Cook presses forward to that one and blocks it.
Fuller on off, firmly driven by Cook back down the track. Bird makes an unintentional stop with his right foot.
Length ball outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Good length around off, Cook stays in the crease and defends it well.
Slower through the air on off, du Plessis leans forward and clips it just past short leg towards mid-wicket.
Drifting in from around off, Faf leans into it and blocks it.
Loopy on off, turning in, du Plessis stays back and defends it well.
Drifting in on off, Faf stays back and defends it well.
Flighted outside off, Cook gets back and clips it with the turn past short leg for a run.
Floated outside off, Cook stays in the crease and blocks it on to the track.
Fuller on off, pushed off the front foot towards the bowler.
Back of a length outside off, Faf stays back and glides it to gully.
Good length closer to off, good leave from the SA skipper.
Length ball just outside off, Faf gets behind the line and blocks it firmly to cover-point.
Back of a length around off, defended well off the back foot.

FOUR! Edge flies through! Good length around off, shapes away a touch as Faf pushes at it. As he did it with soft hands, the nick doesn't carry to Khawaja at third slip. It gets through the cordon towards the third man fence.
BIRD back on for a bowl.
Loopy on middle and leg, defends it off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
A slip comes in.
Floated outside off, Cook clips it towards the leg side.
Drifting in on middle, worked to long on for a single.
Flatter outside off, defended solidly off the back foot.
Floated on middle and leg, worked to the leg side for a run.

That's gone through everybody! Sharp turn for Lyon. Floated outside off, on a length and turns into appreciably to sneak through bat and pad. Gets past Wade too as it goes to the deep. Three leg byes taken.
Good length angled away outside off, pushed off the back foot towards the silly mid off region.
Dug in short outside off, Cook evades it from the line of the bumper.
Good length around off, pushed off the front foot towards point.
Good length angled away well outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Fuller on leg stump, Cook flicks but straight to mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, Cook reaches out to that one and taps it to short cover.
Loopy outside off, Faf hangs back to that one and blocks.
Floated outside off, Faf stays back to block but gets it off the bottom half on to the pitch.
Flighted on a length outside off, defended well from the crease.
Drifting in around off, Cook gets across and clips it behind square for a single.
Fuller on middle, driven through mid on for a single.
Floated outside off, Cook pushes at it but gets it off the inside half to short fine leg. Single taken.
Time for some spin then. NATHAN LYON comes into the attack. A slip and a short leg in place.
Fuller on middle, Faf gets across and blocks it firmly off the front foot.
Too full and well outside off, Faf watches it pass by.
Short of a length around off, climbing on to Faf who rises on his toes to tap it towards point.
Length ball angled in from just outside off, no shot offered.
Switches to around the wicket.
FOUR! Sublime shot! Fuller ball outside off, Faf leans into it and plays a crunchy drive past a diving Warner at extra cover. Superbly timed and it raced away to the fence.
Almost chopped on! Length ball on off, Faf pushes tamely at it and gets an inside edge on to his back leg. That could have gone anywhere.
Fuller outside off, defended firmly off the front foot.
Fuller on off, tails in sharply to rap Cook on the pads as he plays across the line. Huge lbw appeal but turned down. Did too much probably. Yup, replays confirm it to be missing leg stump.
Good length around off, Cook defends it solidly from the crease.
Fullish on middle, dug out towards mid on for a sharp single. Had to hurry but they did well in the end.
Fuller on the pads, Cook shuffles across and tucks it through mid-wicket. Doesn't make the fence but they get three more.
Good length on middle and leg, worked off the back foot to mid-wicket.
Back of a length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot.

FOUR! Another freebie put away. Starc hasn't hit the radar in this spell at all. Too full and on the pads, Faf shuffles and gets his bat down in time to drill it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Quick hands from the SA skipper.
Length ball outside off, no shot offered to that one.

FOUR! Too straight and Faf puts it away. Full on the pads, du Plessis clips it down the leg side to the fine leg fence. It was in the air for a while and Wade dived full length to his left but he was never going to reach it.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Dug in short around off, Cook ducks under the bumper.
Good length outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Length ball outside off, Cook reaches out and taps it to cover.
Full and around off, zips in a touch as Cook defends it off the front foot.
Full and a hint of inswing from around off, Cook gets forward and blocks it solidly by covering the movement.
Fuller on the pads, Cook shuffles and clips it through square leg for a brace.
JOSH HAZLEWOOD has a change of ends.
That climbed on him! Back of a length on leg stump, Faf goes back on his toes to counter the rising ball near the pitch. He collects the ball and throws it towards Starc who isn't amused.
Length ball sprayed down the leg side, Faf looks to glance it but misses.
Length ball wider outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Full outside off, Faf gets on the front foot and blocks it.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
FOUR! Easy pickings for du Plessis. Starc begins with a loosener on the pads. Faf clips it deftly down the leg side past the keeper to the fine leg fence.
MITCHELL STARC is back on.
Pitched up outside off, Cook gets forward and defends it well.
Good length on the pads, worked behind square for a single.
Full and outside off, Faf dishes out the push drive through extra cover for a couple.
Gets the edge but doesn't carry. Bird finally gets hits the good length around off. Squares up Faf as he pokes tentatively at it. The outside edge falls short of Smith at second slip.
Too full on middle, Cook bunts it through mid on. Won't get the boundary this time but three more runs added.
Two gullies come in.

FOUR! Bird continues to leak runs! Full and wide outside off, Cook opens the bat face to steer it through backward point. Finds the fence with ease there. Not exactly where he wanted to play but was relatively in control.
Length ball outside off, shaping away but the line is too wide. Left alone.
FAF DU PLESSIS walks out to bat.

OUT! Edged...and gone! Another huge blow dealt by Hazlewood. Full and outside off, a hint of shape inward as Duminy goes for the drive. Gets a faint inside edge that settles nicely into Wade's gloves. The morning continues to get better for the Aussies as the in-form JP departs.
Length ball outside off, just a bit wide to make Duminy play.
Good length just outside off, a bit of shape away as Duminy lets it pass.
Length ball too wide outside off, easy leave for Duminy.
Good length on leg stump, Duminy misses the flick and is rapped high on the pads.
Drinks break....
Full outside off, no shot offered by Cook.
Fuller on off, Duminy gets it off the inside half of the bat through fine leg for a single. That was close!
Fuller outside off, Cook presses forward and drives it past Warner at cover for a single.
Good length outside off, bounces a lot more, Cook drops his wrists and lets it go.
Angled on middle, Cook keeps it out from his crease.
Fuller on middle, Cook clips it through mid-wicket from his crease for a couple of runs.
On off, swings in late, Duminy goes for the drive but gets it towards short mid-wicket off the inside half of the bat. End of a good over from Josh!
Bowls it on off, Duminy leaves it on the length and the ball flies over the stumps.
FOUR! Nice intent! Fuller outside off, Duminy presses forward and drives it on the up through covers. Warner gives it a chase from covers but fails to stop the ball.
Good leave! Slanted on a length outside off, Duminy is in two minds, whether to play or leave ends up leaving it. The ball just whizzes past the off stump.
Slanted outside off, left alone by Duminy.
JP DUMINY strides in to bat.

OUT! Good grab, Renshaw! Hazlewood bowls it on a length outside off, the ball pitches and goes away just a touch. Amla has to play at it and gets an outside edge which flies to the right of Matt Renshaw who dives to his right and takes a good catch. Amla has another failure, Hazlewood has one to his name too. Australia are now bowling the right lines and lengths.
Angled on a length on off, Cook places it towards mid-wicket off the inside half of the bat.
Fuller outside off, Cook comes forward and pushes it towards covers.
Good length outside off, left alone by Cook.
Fuller on off, Amla defends it with an inside edge through backward square leg for a single.
Angled on a fuller length on middle and leg, clipped through square leg for a run.
FOUR! Hit away! Low full toss, Cook gets across and clips it through wide mid on for a boundary. That was sweetly timed.
Angled on a length on middle, Amla clips it off his hips towards square leg for a couple of runs.
Pitched up outside off, Amla presses forward and defends it.

Fuller outside off, Cook taps it towards covers and takes off for a quick single. Warner has a shy at the stumps from mid off but Cook dives to get into his crease. Had he hit, that would have been close.
Fuller outside off, swings in late but goes away after pitching, left alone by Cook.
Full outside off, Cook comes forward and drives it through covers for a couple of runs.
Bowls it outside off, Cook pushes it towards covers.
HAZLEWOOD returns for a bowl. He has a change of ends.
Fuller outside off, Amla covers the line and defends it.
Hurls it on a length outside off, Amla lets it go.
Length on off, Amla punches it down the ground through mid off. Warner gives it a chase and keeps them to a couple of runs.
Pitched up outside off, too wide from Australia since the morning to induce any false shot.
Outside off, left alone by Amla as the ball swings late.
Fuller outside off, Amla is calm and lets it go through.

FOUR Leg Byes! Shout for an lbw but not given! Too full on leg, Cook looks to clip it through but is hit on his pads. The ball runs down to the fine leg fence. They contemplate a review but Smith reckons it was missing the leg pole. Leg byes signaled.
Fuller outside off, no shot offered by Cook.
Good length outside off, Cook raises his bat and lets it go through. Starc has a few words to say to Cook who does not bother much.
Too full on off, Cook keeps it out towards mid-wicket from his crease.
Well played? Maybe. Bowls it a touch short on off, comes in and bounces a bit too, Cook lets it go pushing his stomach back and getting out of the way in time.
Cook stays in his crease and defends it.
Cook presses forward and pushes it to covers and calls Amla through for a quick single.
Pitched up outside off, Cook covers the line and defends it.
Very full outside off, Cook drives it through covers for a couple of runs.
Good length outside off, Cook defends it towards point off his crease.
FOUR! EDGED! Outside off on a length, Cook is drawn into the drive. He gets it between gully and backward point for a boundary. Replays show Bird had overstepped there but the umpire did not spot it.
Good length outside off, Cook defends it from his crease.
JACKSON BIRD is the new bowler.
Attempts a yorker first up but ends up spraying it down the leg side, Amla fails to clip it.
HASHIM AMLA is the new man in.

OUT! Starc is looking back to check if it is a no ball or not! Bowls it outside off, Elgar pokes at it from his crease. He gets an outside edge that carries to Usman Khawja at third slip. Starc is pumped up and why not, finally Australia have a wicket. Elgar walks back disappointed, he was pushing at that one with hard hands.
Outside off on a length, left alone by Elgar.
Shorter length on middle, Elgar ducks under it easily.
Fuller on middle, Elgar clips it towards mid-wicket from his crease.
Length but down the leg side, clipped through backward square leg for a single.
EDGED! On a length on middle, Elgar gets an edge that just falls short of the third slip fielder. Hazlewood has made the new ball count, unlike Starc.
Full outside off, left alone again by Elgar.
On a length outside off, Elgar keeps it out from his crease.
Another one outside off, left alone.
FOUR! STREAKY! Outside off on a fuller length, Elgar goes at it with hard hands and gets it past Handscomb at gully for a boundary.
bowls a length ball angling into the stumps, Elgar looks to clip but is hit on his pads. Hazlewood appeals at first but then himself acknowledges that there was an inside edge there.
Fuller on off, comes in, Cook clips it towards the on side from his crease.
Fuller on middle and leg, Cook clips it towards mid-wicket but on the bounce to the fielder.
Fuller outside off, Cook places it towards cover-point from his crease.
On a length on middle, Cook plays it back down the wicket.
Sprayed wide outside off, no shot offered.
NASTY! Bowls it outside off, Elgar looks to fend it away taking the bottom hand off that one. The ball rolls towards square leg for a single. That was nicely played.
Angled on a fuller length outside off, Cook presses forward and defends it.
Fuller outside off, swings away, Cook lets it go through.
Angled on a length outside off, Cook comes forward and defends it.
This one is left alone by Cook.
Good length outside off, Cook pushes it towards point from his crease.
Hurls it on a length on off, Cook covers the line and defends it.
This time he clips it towards fine leg for a single.

NOT OUT! Finally Starc gets his radar right and but gets his footing wrong! Starc spears this one on off, Cook is beaten all ends up and is rapped on the pads. The players go up in an appeal and the umpire upholds it. The third umpire is referred to check for the no ball and replays confirm Starc had overstepped there. What a moment, can Cook make this count? He was walking off in a hurry when the fourth umpire ran down the stairs to stop Cook from crossing over.
Cook has been given out lbw. They are checking for the no ball. Seems like Starc is in trouble.
Sprayed wide outside off, Cook lets it be.
Good take! Swings this down the leg side, Cook fails to clip it. Wade dives to his right and makes a superb take.
Slanted way outside off, nothing doing from Cook.
Fuller outside off, no shot offered by Cook to that one.
On a length on middle, Cook clips it towards mid-wicket from his crease.
Good length on middle, Elgar is hit on his body as he fails to clip that one through. Mild appeal turned down.
Slanted on a length outside off, left alone by Elgar.
BEATEN! Bowls it outside off, Elgar comes forward to defend but is beaten all ends up. That too flew through to the keeper.
Elgar gets in line and tucks it towards square leg from his crease.
On off, Elgar comes forward and defends it towards mid-wicket from his crease off the inside half of the bat.
Fuller outside off, left alone by Elgar as it was way wide.
JOSH HAZLEWOOD to bowl from the other end.
Outside off, on a length, left alone by Cook. That carried through nicely.
Hurls it on a fuller length on off, placed towards point from his crease.
Full outside off, Cook pushes it out from his crease.
FOUR!  EDGED! Full outside off, Cook pushes at it and gets it past a diving third slip fielder for a boundary. He gets off the mark in a streaky fashion.
Bowls it on middle, Cook looks to clip but is hit on his pads. There is a loud appeal but that always looked high. Also Cook was hopping a touch.
Begins with a fuller one outside off, Cook keeps it out from his crease.
Game time! The players are out in the middle. STEPHEN COOK and DEAN ELGAR stride out to open batting for South Africa. Australia begin with MITCHELL STARC...
AUSTRALIA XI - David Warner, Matt Renshaw, Usman Khawaja, Steven Smith(c), Peter Handscomb, Nic Maddinson, Matthew Wade(wk), Mitchell Starc, Josh Hazlewood, Nathan Lyon, Jackson Bird.
SOUTH AFRICA XI - Stephen Cook, Dean Elgar, Hashim Amla, Jean-Paul Duminy, Faf du Plessis(c), Temba Bavuma, Quinton de Kock(wk), Vernon Philander, Kyle Abbott, Kagiso Rabada, Tabraiz Shamsi.
TOSS - SOUTH AFRICA WIN THE TOSS AND HAVE ELECTED TO BAT. Australia had already announced their XI. For South Africa, Tabraiz Shamsi is making his Test debut. We will have the teams for you in a bit.

Australia have not had a good time and them handing debuts to three players in a Test has not happened often. It just signifies the state of the Australian cricket. They have never lost all three games of a 3-match Test series at home and they are up against it. Matt Renshaw, Peter Handscomb and Nic Maddison are the ones making their debut and the hosts will hope they come good.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of the final Test between Australia and South Africa at the Adelaide Oval. The series may have been decided but there is a lot at stake. It is a historic match - the first ever D/N game for South Africa and they will be wanting to ensure a good performance to seal the 3-0 series win. There has been a lot of off field drama to distract them and with the skipper Faf du Plessis at the center of it, he will want to lead from the front.
